items.heading: 八年级上册 Module 10 The weather
items.topic: 天气（may/might）；词汇对齐：cloud / shower / snow / storm / cloudy / rainy / snowy / sunny / windy / skate / thick / ice / joke / might / temperature / minus / degree / although / wet / neither / terrible / wish / probably / come on / mile / round / northwest / southeast / from time to time

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: What are you doing this weekend, Tom?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: I'm not sure. It depends on the weather.

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: Look at the clouds. It might rain, so we may not be able to go skating.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: I saw the weather report. The temperature will probably go down to minus five degrees tonight. It's going to be very cold.

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: If the ice is thick enough, we can skate. But if it snows, the roads will be wet and terrible.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Let's wait and see. It may be snowy in the north, but it's usually sunny here.

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: Come on, we can't stay inside all day. If the weather is fine, it's a chance to go out.

reading.title: The Weather Changes
paragraphs: The weather is different in different places. In the northwest, the wind often blows for many days, and the sky is grey. In the southeast, there are showers from time to time, and it rains a lot in July.

Sometimes the weather changes in a strange way. In the morning, the sky is clear and sunny. At noon, dark clouds appear, and the sun disappears. Then the wind gets up, the temperature drops to a low point, and a storm comes suddenly. People run indoors and wish they had brought an umbrella. After an hour, the rain stops, and the sun shines again. That is how it goes, again and again.

This is not a joke. A sudden change in the weather can be dangerous. Although we cannot stop rain or snow, we can still pay attention to it. If it might snow, we wear warm clothes. If there is ice on the road, we walk slowly and do not drive fast. If a storm is coming, we stay away from windows and wait until it is over.
Weather is never boring for the people who live here. It is a little bit of everything: hot and cold, wet and dry, fine and terrible. You never know what it will be like tomorrow.

words.sentence: The temperature will probably go down...
It rains a lot...（rainy 拓展）
The wind often blows...（windy 扩展）
If the ice is thick enough...
...if there is ice on the road.
Neither of us likes the cold.（拓展）
Come on, we can't stay inside...
We walked round the lake.（拓展）

items.heading: 八年级上册 Module 11 Way of life
items.topic: 生活方式与习俗；词汇对齐：cap / chess / set / a chess set / chopstick / toy / video / video game / gift / surprise / immediately / difference / accept / tradition / example / for example / must / month / serious / taste / experience / stay / someone / for the first time / sandwich / chip / fish and chips / onto / gentleman / shoulder

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: I'm having dinner with a British family tonight. What should I do?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: You must be polite and wait for them to start. Also, when you get a gift, you should open it in front of them.

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: Really? In my country, we usually open a gift later.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: That's a small difference. Here, people use a knife and fork, and they often have fish and chips.

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: Do I have to use chopsticks?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: No, for Western food you use a knife and fork. It is a good experience for you.

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: Thanks. It's my first time, so I'll try to remember your advice.

reading.title: At the Dinner Table
paragraphs: Different countries have different ways of life. Some of them are small, but they can be very serious traditions. For people who visit a new place for the first time, it is important to know what to do.

In Britain, for example, people usually have a cup of tea with milk, and a west-country dinner often includes fish and chips. At the table, a gentleman may hold the door open for others, and he often helps the person next to him. When guests arrive, a host may offer them a small gift, such as a toy or a video game for a child.

When you receive a gift, you should accept it with a smile and open it immediately. In some cultures, the words "thank you" are enough. In others, you must say something about the present, or it may seem that you do not like it.

At the dinner table, there are also rules. You should not start eating before the host. You should keep your hands above the table, and if you need something, you should ask someone to pass it to you. An important rule is simple: be polite, and enjoy the experience of trying new food and new ways.
People say that the best way to understand a country is to sit down and eat with its people. When you taste their food, you taste their way of life.

words.sentence: A gentleman may hold the door open...
Put it onto the table.（拓展）

items.heading: 八年级上册 Module 12 Help
items.topic: 急救与安全；词汇对齐：broken / glass / stairs / aid / first aid / medical / imagine / bottom / at the bottom of / wrong / trouble / lift / lift up / harmful / drop / training / make sure / cover / earthquake / warn / inside / under / window / keep / clear / keep clear of / calm / brave / helpful / power

dialogue.speaker: May
dialogue.text: Ben, are you all right? What happened?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: I fell down the stairs and I think my leg is broken. It really hurts.

dialogue.speaker: May
dialogue.text: Don't move. Let me help you. First, we should call for medical help.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: My phone is at the bottom of my bag. I can't reach it.

dialogue.speaker: May
dialogue.text: It's OK. I'll call the doctor and stay with you. Keep calm.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: What should I do while we wait?

dialogue.speaker: May
dialogue.text: Just stay still and keep clear of the edge. Lift your head a little if you can.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: That helps. Thank you, May. You are so helpful.

reading.title: Help Comes First
paragraphs: Accidents can happen at any time. When they do, knowing what to do is very important. The most useful thing we can learn, after the habit of being careful, is first aid.

If someone falls and breaks an arm, do not move the person. Instead, stay calm and call for medical help. Make sure the area is safe, and keep people clear of the injured person. If there is blood, cover the wound with a clean cloth and press it gently. This can reduce the pain until a doctor arrives.

In an earthquake, the rules are different. First, stay inside and get under a strong table. Keep away from windows, because broken glass can be harmful. If the ground is shaking, drop, cover and hold on. After the shaking stops, leave the building carefully and do not use the stairs; use the exit steps beside the building, or a safe door.

We cannot always stop accidents from happening. But we can prepare ourselves for them. Schools teach students about danger, and some towns even warn people by giving them training on how to react. When we keep these simple rules in our minds, we can be brave and helpful when it matters most. That is the true power of help.

words.sentence: Make sure the area is safe...
Can you imagine the danger?（拓展）

items.heading: 八年级上册 Module 1 How to learn English

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: Hi, Tom. You look worried. What's the matter?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: I'm a little shy, and I often make mistakes when I speak English. I understand English when I read it, but I can't say anything naturally.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: That's very common. Do you have any good advice from your teacher?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: She said I should pronounce every word aloud and practise speaking every day. But I always forget the words the next day.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: Maybe you should write down the new words in a notebook and look them up in a dictionary. A good memory comes from a good habit.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Do you think it's a good idea to read aloud?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: Of course. Reading aloud helps you remember the spelling and the grammar at the same time.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: What else can I do?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: Try to find a conversation partner. If you talk to others quickly, you'll become more confident.

reading.title: A Better Way to Learn English
paragraphs: Many students say that English is difficult, but the problem is not the language. It is the way they study.

First, do not try to remember every word alone. Words live in sentences. When you meet a new word, look it up in a dictionary, write it down, and then make a sentence with it. In this way, you will not only learn the word but also learn how to use it.

Second, speak aloud. It sounds simple, but it is very helpful. When you read a short passage aloud, you improve your pronunciation and your listening at the same time. You also begin to feel more natural about the sound of English.

Third, keep a small notebook. Every day after class, write down three new words and one important sentence from the lesson. Read the notebook before you go to bed, and again the next morning. This little habit is the secret to a strong memory.

Finally, do not be shy. Make mistakes, and learn from them. When you ask for help, your teacher and friends are happy to give you advice. Conversation is the best classroom, and practice is the best teacher.
If you follow these simple steps, you will slowly improve. Little by little, English will become a friend instead of a problem.

words.sentence: Do you have any good advice...?
You should pronounce every word aloud.
Try to find a conversation partner.
If you talk to others quickly...

items.heading: 八年级上册 Module 2 My home town and my country
items.topic: 家乡与国家（形容词比较级）；词汇对齐：hill / population / wide / million / north / south / west / especially / be famous for / university / island / area / low / mountain / countryside / umbrella / pretty good

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Where do you come from, Mark?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: I come from a small town in the north of England. It is much smaller than this city.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Really? What is it like?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: It is very quiet and pretty. There are low hills and a wide river, and the countryside is green all year round.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Is it famous for anything?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: Yes, it is famous for its old university. Many visitors come here, especially in summer.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: What about the population?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: Only about two hundred thousand people. It is not as crowded as a big city.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: It sounds like a nice home town. I would like to visit it one day.

reading.title: My Home Town
paragraphs: My home town is a small town in the north of my country. It is a quiet place with a population of about two hundred thousand. You will not find any tall buildings here. Instead, you will see low houses, green hills and a wide river running through the town.

The town is famous for its old university. Students come from all over the country to study here, especially in autumn when the leaves turn red. In summer, visitors sit by the river and watch the boats, and they often say that the town is very pretty.
We also have some beautiful mountains and an island near the coast, but the countryside is my favourite part. It is quiet and clean, and the air is fresh.

People sometimes ask me why I do not want to move to a bigger city. I always give the same answer: a big city is exciting, but my home town is where my heart is. It may be small, but it is pretty good.

words.sentence: ...with a population of about two hundred thousand.
The town is famous for its old university.
...a wide river running through the town.
We also have some beautiful mountains...

items.heading: 八年级上册 Module 3 Sports
items.topic: 体育运动（比较级与最高级）；词汇对齐：baseball / volleyball / boring / exciting / relaxing / score / already / matter / hurt / enjoyable / Olympics / stadium / miss / mind / plenty of / beat / careless / cheer...on / coach / against / train / practice / warm-up / usual / better / after-school / pleased / pass / pity / chance / loudly / confident

dialogue.speaker: Jack
dialogue.text: Are you going to watch the football match tonight?

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.text: I am. It is the final, and the two teams are both very strong.

dialogue.speaker: Jack

dialogue.speaker: Ben

dialogue.speaker: Jack

dialogue.speaker: Ben

reading.title: A Better Player
paragraphs: Last year, Leo was a careless player. He was fast, but he never listened to his coach, and he often missed easy chances. His team always lost, and Leo felt sorry. He was not pleased with himself.

Then he decided to change. He began to do warm-up exercises every day, and he practised after school for an hour. His coach taught him how to pass the ball and how to play against strong teams. Slowly, Leo became more careful and more confident.

This year, his team is the best in the school. They have scored many goals, and Leo has scored more than anyone else. "Sports is not only about winning," Leo says. "It is about learning to work together. Playing football is exciting, but working with my team is even more enjoyable."

Now Leo is the most important player on the team. He does not miss his chances any more, and his teammates cheer him on loudly. This autumn, they will take part in the school Olympics. Leo says he is ready and he is not afraid.

items.heading: 八年级上册 Module 4 Planes, ships and trains
items.topic: 交通出行（最高级）；词汇对齐：road / accident / except / choice / classmate / far from / close / crowded / all the time / journey / book / park / outside / however / cost

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: How did you get to school today, Sam?

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.text: I took the underground. It is the fastest way, and it is not crowded at seven o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: But it costs a lot. I think the bus is cheaper.

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.text: The bus is too slow. It stops all the time, and sometimes there is an accident on the road.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: That is true. However, I live far from school, so the bus is the only choice without my parents' car.

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.text: What about the train? It is the most comfortable way to travel.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: I agree. Last month I took the train to visit my uncle, and I booked my ticket on my phone.

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.text: Nice. When I grow up, I want to travel by plane, the fastest way of all.

reading.title: How Do We Travel?
paragraphs: People travel in different ways. We walk, ride bicycles, take buses, drive cars, catch trains and fly in planes. Each way has its own good points and bad points.
The underground is usually the quickest way to move around a big city. It is fast, and it is never too crowded if you start early. However, it can cost a lot, and you have to wait for the next train.
The bus is cheaper. It stops near your home, and you can see the city outside the window. But it is often late, and it is crowded all the time because many people use it.
Trains are comfortable. You can stand up, walk around, and enjoy a long journey. They are good for travelling between cities, but not every town has a train station.
Planes are the fastest, but they are not always close to the city centre. You have to travel to the airport, so a short trip does not always save time.

Many students in my class walk or take the bus to school. My classmate, however, lives far from school, so he takes the underground every morning. He says it is the best choice, because he never wants to be late.

words.sentence: It is not crowded at seven o'clock.
However, I live far from school...
...there is an accident on the road.
...not always close to the city centre.
I found a place to park my bike.（拓展）

items.heading: 八年级上册 Module 5 Lao She Teahouse
items.topic: 老舍茶馆与中国文化；词汇对齐：actress / teahouse / offer / end / in the end / no idea / act / show / common / twentieth / describe / society / head teacher / college / novel / name / if / magic

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Have you ever been to a teahouse in China?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: Yes, I went to a famous teahouse in Beijing with my parents. The show was about the changes in Chinese society.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: That sounds interesting. Do you remember the name of the play?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: No idea! But I know that an old writer named Lao She wrote it. He is very famous.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Did you like the actors?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: Yes, the actress who played the main character was great. At the end, everybody clapped.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: I'd like to go there too. Can you take me one day?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll book the tickets and we can watch a tea show together.

reading.title: A Cup of Tea and a Story
paragraphs: In the centre of Beijing there is an old teahouse with a warm, common name. Every evening, visitors come in from the street, sit at round tables, and wait for the show to begin.

The play is named after a great writer. Over a hundred years ago, he wrote about a family, a teahouse and the changes in Chinese society. The show is not a long novel, but it tells a big story. It describes how people lived and how times changed.

On the stage, the actors move and talk while the audience drinks tea. The main actress plays a kind woman, and her performance makes the whole show feel like magic. Some who watch it for the first time have no idea how the story will end. In the end, many of them feel sad, but everyone claps.

Today, the teahouse is a common place for students and travellers. If you visit Beijing, you should not miss it. It is a wonderful way to understand Chinese culture, and a chance to enjoy a cup of tea and a story at the same time.

The main actress plays a kind woman...

items.heading: 八年级上册 Module 6 Animals in danger
items.topic: 濒危动物与环保；词汇对齐：snake / neck / thin / danger / in danger / at last / interested / allow / think of / protect / wild / grow / take away / enough / peace / in peace / notice / look after / raise / research / baby / situation / scientist / produce / southwest / in order to / government / set up / nature / develop / feed / symbol

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.text: Did you read about the pandas last night?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Yes. They are in danger, aren't they?

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.text: Right. There are only a few thousand left in the wild, so scientists are worried about the situation.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: What are they doing to protect them?

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.text: They set up nature parks in the southwest of China. The pandas can live and feed in peace there.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: That sounds good. Do they look after the babies?

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.text: Yes. Scientists raise the baby pandas and take away the danger. In order to help them, the government gives enough land to the parks.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: I'm glad people are interested in saving them. Pandas are a symbol of China.

reading.title: Saving the Pandas
paragraphs: The giant panda is a symbol of China and a favourite of people around the world. Sadly, it is also in danger. In the past, there were many pandas in the wild, but now there are only a few thousand. Scientists say the main problem is that pandas do not have enough bamboo to eat.

Pandas live in the mountains of the southwest of China. As towns grow, the bamboo forests become smaller, and the wild animals have less food and less space. A panda baby is very small, and it cannot look after itself. In the wild, many babies do not grow up because they are cold or hungry.

To help the pandas, the government has set up nature parks and reserves. Scientists work there all year. They research the pandas, feed them, and raise the babies until they are strong. They also plant bamboo, so the pandas have enough food to live in peace.
After years of hard work, the number of pandas is slowly growing. This gives scientists hope. They believe that if we protect nature and wild animals, the pandas will always be with us.

It makes me think of nature.（拓展）

There is a snake in the zoo.（拓展）

items.heading: 八年级上册 Module 7 A famous story
items.topic: 著名故事（过去进行时）；词汇对齐：fall / follow / hole / rabbit / ssh / ground / tea party / twice / once or twice / suddenly / pink / pocket / field / think about / deep / while / land / dry

dialogue.speaker: Mum
dialogue.text: What are you reading, Lucy?

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: A famous story about a girl and a rabbit. While she was sitting in a garden, she suddenly saw a rabbit running past her.

dialogue.speaker: Mum
dialogue.text: Did the rabbit speak?

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: Yes! The rabbit was looking at a small watch and saying, "Oh dear, I'm late!" The girl was so surprised that she followed it into a deep hole.

dialogue.speaker: Mum
dialogue.text: And what happened next?

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: She fell and landed on the ground, and then she came to a strange tea party. People were sitting around a table while she was wondering where she was.

dialogue.speaker: Mum
dialogue.text: What a wonderful story! I think I have read it once or twice myself.

reading.title: Down the Rabbit Hole
paragraphs: One hot afternoon, a girl was sitting quietly in a garden with her sister. She was feeling bored, and she did not know what to do. Then she saw a white rabbit running past her. It was not a common rabbit, because it was wearing a coat and carrying a watch.

The rabbit stopped for a moment, took the watch out of its pocket, and looked at it. "Oh dear, oh dear, I'm late!" it cried. Before the girl could think about it, the rabbit jumped into a small hole under a tree.

The girl was very interested, so she followed it. She ran, and then she began to fall down, down, down into a very deep hole. The hole was so deep that she thought she was falling all the way to the other side of the world.

At the bottom, she landed softly on the ground. Around her, the dry earth had turned into a strange, beautiful land. A small door stood in the wall, and she could hear the sound of a tea party coming from behind it.
The girl did not know where she was, but she was not afraid. She was still thinking about the rabbit, and she wanted to find it. And that is how her wonderful adventure began.

items.heading: 八年级上册 Module 8 Accidents
items.topic: 事故与急救；词汇对齐：pale / appear / round / corner / hit / glad / in time / fall off / risk / attention / pay attention / side / side by side / bite / climb / hide / throw / fridge / pain / worse / medicine

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Come in and sit down. What's the matter?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: I fell off my bike on my way to school. My knee hurts and the skin is broken.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: When did it happen?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: About half an hour ago. A car appeared suddenly at the corner, and I had to stop. I was lucky that it didn't hit me, but I fell to the side of the road.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Does it hurt a lot?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Yes, and it's getting worse.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Let me look. Don't worry, it's not too bad. You need to keep the wound clean and take some medicine. Please pay attention to the traffic next time.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: I will. Thank you, doctor.

reading.title: A Lucky Day
paragraphs: Last Monday was a cold day. Ben was riding his bike to school, thinking about the maths test. He was not paying attention to the road, so he did not see the car coming around the corner.
The driver shouted, and the car stopped just in time. But Ben was so surprised that he fell off his bike and hit the ground. His face turned pale, and his arm was in pain.

A kind woman came to help him. She took Ben's bag, and together they walked to the side of the road. "Are you all right?" she asked. "You must pay attention to the traffic. Cars can appear very suddenly."
Ben thanked her and checked his arm. The skin was hurt but not broken. He was glad that nothing worse had happened.
That evening, his mother cleaned the cut and gave him some medicine. She told him to be more careful the next time.
Now, whenever Ben rides his bike, he always looks round before he turns. He knows that a small mistake can lead to a big accident, and that safety comes first.

words.sentence: He looks round before he turns.
(拓展) Riding fast is a risk.

items.heading: 八年级上册 Module 9 Population
items.topic: 人口问题；词汇对齐：noise / prepare / report / billion / huge / increase / hang on / notes / cause / problem / grow / birth / flat / rubbish / quiet / local / close down / mention / pollution / solve / public / service / pupil / reduce / create

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.text: We are going to write a report about our town. What problems does it have?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: The population is growing very fast. More and more people are moving in, so there is a huge increase in traffic and noise.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: That's true. Lots of new flats are being built, but our streets are still crowded.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.text: What about the environment?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: There is too much rubbish, and the pollution from cars is getting worse. It is a serious problem.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: I think the local government should create more public services and schools.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.text: Good idea. When you write your report, remember to take notes, and mention some ways to reduce the problem.

reading.title: A Growing Town
paragraphs: Our town is not big, but it is growing quickly. Twenty years ago, only a few thousand people lived here. Today, the population is over three hundred thousand, and the number is still increasing every year.

This growth brings both good things and bad things. On the one hand, new schools, shops and public services are being built, so there are more jobs. On the other hand, life is becoming noisier and more crowded. The streets are full of cars, and the problem of pollution is getting worse. Large buildings and new flats take the place of quiet fields and gardens.
Some local people are worried. They say that too much traffic and rubbish cause health problems. They also want the government to build more homes before the town gets too crowded.

How can we solve these problems? First, we should reduce the rubbish we make and reuse what we use. Second, we can walk or take the bus instead of driving a car. Third, the government must plan for the future before the population grows too large.
A town is like a family. It grows, and it must look after itself. If people and the government work together, our town will be a good place to live.

We are going to write a report...
(拓展) Every pupil needs a school.
How can we solve these problems?
